subject.title: Wear: animate Talk avatar from playback audio

question: Should Wear Talk adopt the animated canonical OpenClaw avatar as its default realtime presentation instead of the existing orb and waveform?
rationale: This is a new user-facing visual language and interaction-state presentation, not a correction to a documented broken contract; implementation quality alone cannot establish whether the product should standardize it.

options.title: Sponsor the avatar direction
options.body: Approve the visual replacement subject to independently inspectable physical Wear proof of playback, reset, and preserved Talk gestures.

options.title: Keep the current presentation
options.body: Retain the existing orb and waveform until a broader native-app visual direction explicitly includes this Wear experience.

options.title: Request a narrower prototype
options.body: Ask for a smaller, reviewable experiment before replacing the default Talk presentation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the avatar direction
recommendation.body: Approve the visual replacement subject to independently inspectable physical Wear proof of playback, reset, and preserved Talk gestures.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current prototype, but approval should be confirmed by a repository product owner not identified in the available history.
